propositions: When structured parsing exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in the prompted branch of _pai_structured, the raw reply is discarded and the failure becomes non-replayable without a debug artifact.

A new optional config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved on LLMConfig via _llm_str in from_env) enables opt-in capture of the final failed reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count to a timestamped local artifact file.
The artifact write occurs best-effort immediately before the terminal raise last, never masks the original parse error, and is skipped entirely when the key is unset (default=None) or parse succeeds.
Artifacts in the configured directory are rotated by mtime to keep at most 20 newest files, preventing unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
